name: Aibara Natsumi
source:
The main heroine, Kazuki's classmate. The story almost always comes back to her. The natural klutz but kind to everyone character, loves small animals and not good at thinking or at sports.

[Edited from a [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/03/09/hello-world-review/]review[/url] by Warum]
